about.tagline: Your accounts, one window, watertight sessions.
update.title: Updates
update.devDetail: Updates only work from the installed application.
delete.title: Delete service
delete.detail: The service disappears from the sidebar. Its session (logins, cookies) stays on disk unless you tick the box below.
icon.title: Icon for {name}
icon.errorDetail: This file cannot be decoded. Accepted formats: PNG, JPEG, ICO.
picker.title: Add a service
picker.search: Search services, or paste any address
picker.empty: No match. Paste the address above to add it anyway.
form.name: Name
form.sleepHint: Frees memory, but stops badges and notifications until you come back.
form.spoofHint: Required by WhatsApp, which turns Electron browsers away.
form.preloadHint: Without it, no badge and no notification until you first open it.
form.protectedHint: Hides this service behind its own code, asked every time you open it.
form.slotEnd: Appears at the end of the sidebar
overlay.sleepingBody: Its process has been released. Click to wake it.
lock.hint: Locks the window behind a code. Data on disk stays readable outside Soocial: this is a privacy screen, not encryption.
lock.title.enable: Require the code for this service
lock.hintService: This code protects this service only. It hides the view, it does not encrypt data on disk.
serviceLock.title: {name} is locked
serviceLock.hint: Enter the code to open this service.
ob.tagline: All your web apps in one window, each account in its own isolated session.
ob.langHint: You can change the language later from the File menu.
ob.pickHint: Choose what you use every day. You can add several accounts of the same service later, and they will never sign each other out.
mixer.title: Volume mixer
mixer.hint: Applied inside each service. Windows sees Soocial as a single app.
path.error.notAbsolute: The path must be complete (drive letter included).
path.error.invalidChars: The folder name contains a character Windows does not allow.
path.error.reserved: Windows reserves this folder name (CON, PRN, COM1…).
path.error.tooLong: The full path is too long for Windows.
path.error.longPath: The path is long: some tools may not handle it.
path.error.driveMissing: That drive is not available on this machine right now.
path.error.noPermission: No write permission there. An administrator is needed, or choose another folder.
path.error.notADirectory: That path is a file, not a folder.
path.error.driveRoot: Installing at the root of a drive is not allowed: choose a folder inside it.
path.error.nestedRoot: Soocial cannot be installed inside itself.
path.error.alreadyInstalled: An installation already uses this folder.
path.error.notEmpty: That folder already contains other files.
download.interruptedBody: The partial file was left next to the destination.
install.title: Application folder
install.hint: Written by the installer. The app never writes there: the folder can sit on a removable disk, and a disconnected disk is not fixed by reinstalling.
install.targetHint: Before installing an update, the app checks that the recorded path is where it actually runs. A doubt stops the update instead of falling back to C:.
install.mismatch: the app does not run where the installer recorded
install.nested: installed inside a folder of the same name
install.repairBody: The app runs somewhere other than the folder recorded at install time. Updates may target the wrong place until the installer is run again.
update.availableMessage: You are on the latest version.
update.readyMessage: The update is downloaded and ready.
update.storeDetail: Microsoft Store installs updates for this app.
update.targetMessage: The folder where the app runs and the folder recorded by the installer disagree.
storage.downloadsHint: Separate from the application folder: an update that replaces the app must never take your files with it.
storage.downloadsWillCreate: will be created on the first download
storage.ask: Ask where to save each download
storage.askHint: Otherwise the file goes to the folder above, without overwriting a same-named file.
settings.subtitle: Everything the app can change, in seven groups.
settings.glassHint: Only the blur costs: Extended blurs more surfaces, None makes everything opaque.
settings.animationsHint: Reduced on slow PCs and for prefers-reduced-motion.
settings.sidebarCollapsedHint: Icons only: more room for the service.
settings.dndHint: Mutes notifications and sounds in every service.
settings.closeToTray: Close button hides to the tray
settings.closeToTrayHint: Otherwise the cross quits the application.
settings.minimizeToTrayHint: The left button goes to the tray instead of the taskbar.
settings.autostartHint: Written in the per-user registry, not in Program Files.
settings.languageHint: System follows the Windows display language.
settings.isolationHint: Each service has its own cookie space. None sees another's session.
settings.clearAllHint: Empties the sessions: services stay installed, accounts sign out.
settings.hardwareAccelerationHint: A restart is required. Turn it off for flickering or black screens with some drivers.
settings.hibernateHint: Set per service; past 5 active services, sleep is what keeps the first five seconds smooth.
settings.servicesHint: Order changes by dragging entries in the sidebar. Deleting a service keeps its data: the session stays until you empty the data folder.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Paths, version, registry, shortcuts, write access. Nothing about your accounts.
home.subtitle: Everything at a glance, then click a tile to open it.
home.empty: No service yet. Add one from the sidebar.
favorites.subtitle: The services you open every day, first.
favorites.emptyHint: Right-click a service, then Star it.
help.subtitle: Shortcuts, links, and the block to paste in a bug report.
help.issueHint: Paste the diagnostic block: it holds the paths, version and registry state.
service.resetDetail: Cookies, local storage and history of this service are deleted. Other services are untouched, and the service itself stays in the sidebar.
privacy.lockHint: Asks for the code each time it opens.
lock.title: Lock code
